textile_clothing.benchmark_product_or_service: Cotton Everyday Kurti / Agrarian Work Shirt
textile_clothing.pricing_strategy_notes: Implement a tiered 3-tier pricing structure: budget cotton daily wear (35% margin), festive embroidered sets (55% margin), and uniform bulk contracts (25% margin with volume guarantees).
textile_clothing.low_capital_strategy: Focus on high-turnover ready-to-wear fast fashion and alter-to-fit service with minimal initial inventory depth.
textile_clothing.high_capital_strategy: Direct wholesale roll sourcing from Surat textile mandis to compress fabric cost by 22% and setup in-house stitching units.

dairy.benchmark_product_or_service: 1 Litre Full-Cream Fresh Milk / 1 Kg Fresh Malai Paneer
dairy.pricing_strategy_notes: Use milk as the high-velocity, daily cash-generating anchor, and capture higher 35%+ gross profit margins on processed items like Paneer, fresh curd, and cultured ghee.
dairy.low_capital_strategy: Aggregate collection from 10-15 trusted smallholder dairy farmers and direct retail delivery to maximize initial cash velocity.
dairy.high_capital_strategy: Invest in a 500-litre bulk milk cooler and automated vacuum sealing for value-added paneer and ghee export packaging.

grocery.benchmark_product_or_service: Standard 5 Kg Monthly Ration Basket (Flour, Pulses, Oil, Sugar)
grocery.pricing_strategy_notes: Maintain competitive price parity with town supermarkets on high-visibility staples (sugar, oil, atta) while generating 25-30% margins on loose spices, unbranded pulses, and impulse confectionary.
grocery.low_capital_strategy: Focus on fast-moving top 40 staples with weekly reordering from nearby wholesale distributors.
grocery.high_capital_strategy: Procure seasonal food grains directly during harvest to capture bulk wholesale trade discounts of 12-15%.

food_processing.benchmark_product_or_service: 200g Branded Stand-up Pouch Ground Spices / Traditional Snack Pack
food_processing.pricing_strategy_notes: Provide 22% retailer trade margin to incentivize village kirana shops to display your brand prominently ahead of established national competitors.
food_processing.low_capital_strategy: Custom jobwork packaging and local distribution to nearby tea stalls and weekly haats.
food_processing.high_capital_strategy: Semi-automated nitrogen-flush pouch packaging with multi-district distribution logistics.

agriculture.benchmark_product_or_service: 1 Quintal (100 Kg) Grade-A Seasonal Horticultural Produce (e.g., Tomatoes / Onions / Chilies)
agriculture.estimated_unit_production_cost: ₹900 - ₹1,200 per quintal (seeds, fertilizer, drip irrigation, harvesting)
agriculture.pricing_strategy_notes: Stagger planting schedules across 3 phases to avoid single-week harvest glut and capture off-season price premiums of up to 40% in peri-urban markets.
agriculture.low_capital_strategy: High-density open field vegetable cultivation with leased tractor implements and manual harvesting.
agriculture.high_capital_strategy: Shade-net / polyhouse nursery cultivation combined with solar micro-irrigation for year-round exotic produce.

handicrafts.benchmark_product_or_service: Handcrafted Terracotta Decor Urn / Handloom Embroidered Shawl
handicrafts.pricing_strategy_notes: Value-based pricing rather than cost-plus pricing. Heritage narrative, artisan identity card, and sustainable plastic-free packaging justify 3x production cost multiples in urban exhibitions.
handicrafts.low_capital_strategy: Direct participation in district Saras melas and craft haats with cash transactions.
handicrafts.high_capital_strategy: Brand creation with studio photography, ONDC/e-commerce listings, and corporate gifting catalogs.

services.benchmark_product_or_service: Comprehensive Two-Wheeler / Tractor Servicing & Maintenance Unit
services.estimated_unit_production_cost: ₹120 base consumables (grease, cleaner, shop overhead) per service
services.pricing_strategy_notes: Offer transparent fixed-rate servicing packages (Basic Tune-up, Monsoon Proofing, General Overhaul) to build customer trust versus unorganized mechanics.
services.low_capital_strategy: Mobile on-call emergency repair service and routine maintenance using portable diagnostic tools.
services.high_capital_strategy: Full-fledged roadside workshop with hydraulic lift, computerized wheel balancing, and genuine spare parts inventory.
